text:
Ana Rivera: Follow-up from the memory postmortem: let's lock owners and minimal rollout criteria for the KV-cache fragmentation fix. Short thread to confirm tasks.
Diego Morales: I'll take repro + nightly allocation dumps. Plan: churn runner + jemalloc stats + perf flamegraphs. ETA 3 days for initial artifacts.
Priya Desai: Runtime will own mitigation and rollout (soft caps + incremental compaction). I'll land a feature-flagged PR for soft caps first. ETA 10d.
Ana Rivera: Action items:
 - Diego: repro harness & nightly traces (ETA 3d)
 - Priya: soft_cap flag + compactor prototype (ETA 10d)
 - Tom B.: dashboards + alerting (ETA 4d)
 - ops-bot: run canary at 5% post-merge
ci-bot: Note: add leak-sanitizer job once repro PR is merged.
Diego Morales: Repro notes: use churn_runner with mixed sizes and TTLs. Example: `./tools/churn_runner --shards=48 --sizes=128,4096,16384 --ttl=60 --duration=180` and collect `curl http://localhost:9100/debug/je_stats` after run.
Priya Desai: Compaction plan: incremental page migration behind flag; consider slab-rewrite if needed. Also soft_limit returns 429 with structured log (shard_id, resident_bytes, frag_ratio).
Ana Rivera: Rollout: dev -> canary 5% for 2h -> ramp to 25% if frag delta <2% and P95 latency unchanged. Abort if write rejections > 1% or error rate rises.
Diego Morales: Found a likely leak path in snapshot builder on error returns. Adding unit test + sanitizer run in CI.
Priya Desai: Adding per-shard hard_limit to reject writes and emit snapshot on breach (runtime owns).
Tom B.: (pasted into thread) I'll add Grafana panels: per-shard resident, allocated, frag_ratio, compaction_runs, 429-counts. Alert at host resident >85% or frag_ratio>1.2 sustained 10m. Notify #eng-runtime and page if host growth >12% in 10m.
ops-bot: Canary scheduled after PR merge; will post start/finish messages here.
Ana Rivera: Weekly 6-week check-ins on Mondays 10am to track regressions. Priya will send invites.
Diego Morales: PR opened for repro infra: perf/repro/1836001111-churn. First heapshots uploaded to the postmortem.
Priya Desai: Soft_cap PR behind flag queued; requesting review from Diego and Ana.
Ana Rivera: Thanks everyone. Update the postmortem checklist with PR links and set status to "in-progress" when started. I'll coordinate blockers in the weekly sync. :white_check_mark:
